summary: ```markdown # Detailed Explanation of New Features in 2025.0 ## Introduction In this live recording, we will discuss the new features introduced in the latest version of Marvelous Designer, version 2025.0. ## UI Interface Update First of all, the first new feature is the update of our UI interface. In the new version of Marvelous Designer, our UV editor has been regarded as a main window. You can directly switch between the UV editor and our 2D version window here. Alternatively, we can place the UV editor alongside other window brands as the main window for inspection. ### Multi-Display Support I use one display here, and if you have multiple displays, you can position it on the secondary screen. Our new version of the UV window has also updated some content. For example, when we select an object material, we can directly switch to its attribute editor. If we choose a tool, such as the button tool, the object window will automatically locate the physical attribute of the button, allowing us to make adjustments. ### Secondary Windows These changes also include secondary windows where our history record or the new module library can be placed on both sides of our screen. These windows can also be independently created or combined, similar to the UI layout changes in our previous version. These layout changes can be customized by everyone. ## Asset Library Updates In the new version, we have also updated the asset library. In addition to new asset files, we have added some new tree types, including updates to virtual models and scenes. The selection process is now more intuitive than in the previous version. ### Default Files As for the default files, they can be found in the old version of the window, which I will introduce later. We have also added a lot of fabric files, which can be located in the Legacy folder within the Fabric folder. ### Fabric Files and Features In the new version, we have updated some water-washing text that can also be used directly. Additionally, new butterfly file previews have been added, along with new scene files that you can use to create effects. The default files from earlier versions are still available in the asset library. ## Library Management You can classify files by type or by date. Clicking on the preview on the right side allows you to see a three-dimensional picture of each file. If a file does not have a three-dimensional picture, it means it may not have been downloaded yet, and you will need to click download. ### Connect Business City Integration On the right side of our library window, we have our Connect Business City, where we can directly call files in our business city within Marvelous Designer. By default, it only shows free files. You can double-click an online file to download it from the background and load these clothing or material files into the current project. ### Digital Assets When selecting an object material, a corresponding Connect Business City page appears in the upper left corner, allowing for quick access to digital assets. This new version of the asset library enables faster import of free assets compared to before. ## Module Library Enhancements The next new feature is our module library. In addition to new module types, our module library has also undergone significant changes. When selecting a module library, you can find the clothing type you need. After selecting the clothing type, you can call component modules at the bottom. ### Module Matching and Simulation After matching components together, you can start the simulation, and it will automatically wear it on our virtual model. If you want to change the module, simply double-click to select a different module. Registered modules can be easily switched, and you can customize the configuration of different styles. ### Module Registration If adjustments are made to a module, you can register it as a module that can be changed later. Simply click the plus sign to select it, then click the enter button to register it. During registration, you can change its name or its shrink chart, and all defaults will already be set. ## Clothing Type Changes In the new version, we can quickly call previously created clothing files. If you want to select this module from other component windows, you can share this component to other clothing types.
